fusions.name: Hoofbeat Seed
fusions.desc: Hurls a spore that deals 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 5 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Trampling Rout
fusions.desc: A rush of spores deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, knocks each back 3.5 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Running Repair
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Its healing rises 10% for every 100 paces you run since you last used it (max 50%).

fusions.name: Lathered Bloom
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
